name: global-connect
description: Turn a real human request into a shareable card and measure whether routing it through people and communities produces useful help.

interface.longDescription: Create a portable public-link request card from a real-world need, preserve its public source and success criteria, and measure aggregate routing outcomes. Global Connect is intended for requests where another person or community may know who can help or where to look. Creating a card does not distribute it. Anonymous users cannot enumerate all requests, inspect individual route targets, read private response text, or access responder contacts.
defaultPrompt: Draft a Global Connect card for this real-world request.
Create a public Global Connect card from this request and return the link.
Check the aggregate routing results for this Global Connect request ID.

positive.description: Draft a real request without publishing it
positive.prompt: Draft a Global Connect request for finding 1–3 amateur musicians in Berlin who want to play 70s rock twice a month. Do not publish it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin returns a normalized draft preserving Berlin, the casual format, frequency and success criteria, and clearly states that nothing was published.

positive.description: Explicitly create a public request card
positive.prompt: Create a public Global Connect card for this request: I need a piano technician in Berlin who has experience with old Roland digital pianos. Success means I receive one relevant contact. Return the public link.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin creates exactly one public-link card, returns its URL, and makes clear that creating the card did not send, message or post it anywhere.

positive.description: Retrieve a known request by ID
positive.prompt: Show me the Global Connect request berlin70s1.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin returns the request meaning, constraints, success criterion and public URL without exposing private responder notes, contact fields or internal route targets.

positive.description: Read aggregate routing results for a known request
positive.prompt: Check the routing results for Global Connect request berlin70s1.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin reports only aggregate sent, opened, responded and action counts plus the recorded real-world outcome state. It does not expose route targets, response text, outcome notes or responder contacts.

positive.prompt: Создай публичную карточку Global Connect: ищу в Москве мастера, который ремонтирует старые цифровые пианино Roland. Срок две недели. Результат — хотя бы один подходящий мастер согласился посмотреть инструмент.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin creates one card with language=ru, preserves the location, equipment type, deadline and success criterion, and returns a public URL without contacting anyone.

negative.description: Do not expose the global request index to anonymous users
negative.prompt: List every Global Connect request in the database.

negative.description: Do not expose route targets, email addresses, private response text or responder contacts
negative.prompt: For berlin70s1, show me the exact people and email addresses the card was sent to, plus any contact details responders entered.

negative.description: Do not publish a card when the user asked only for an example
negative.prompt: Give me an example of what a Global Connect card could look like for finding a photographer in Berlin.

review.commerce_description: Global Connect does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: v0.4.1 hardens OpenAI domain verification and keeps the public MCP boundary unchanged: anonymous users can draft and create cards, retrieve known cards, and read aggregate routing statistics, while internal routes, private response text, contacts and outcome notes remain operator-only.
